title: Extended Conifers
description: This mod adds more coniferous tree types to the game while keeping the vanila feel. This mod is currently still in beta
body: This mod adds more coniferous trees to minecraft including pine, juniper, fir and many more on the way as well as matching biomes for all of them. It adds 5 biomes which will eventually become 13 biomes, the current five are pine forest, old growth pine forest, alpine pine forest, juniper scrubland and mixed pine/juniper forest.
